scope: Fixed-observation symbolic-regression mechanism comparison; not autonomous Agent discovery
observations: E10-20261107-224311/R07: all archived acquired probes in each world
pair_order: world ascending, seed ascending; legacy/joint order alternates by pair index
timing_note: Equal 47-second search budget. Joint preprocessing is measured separately to isolate search-data changes; not a 300-second autonomous session comparison.
primary_selection: Lowest finite raw-training position RMSE among the returned complete top-three candidates after identical refit; tie by original SR rank. Selection is frozen before evaluator access.
primary_metrics: Official clean fixed-case total and prediction score for raw-training-selected candidate
secondary_metrics: Original SR rank-one score and recovery BEFORE external raw refit
Any returned top-three recovered law BEFORE external raw refit
Any top-three recovery AFTER external raw refit
raw training position and velocity residual
scoring_constants: Claims and energy_used copied from each original R07 submission, identical for both arms. Prediction/80 reported separately. Fixed claims may be wrong; these are not new Agent declarations.
recovery_rule: Post-hoc 256 independent legal-domain states with public control variations; acceleration normalized RMSE <= 0.01. Reference fields and test states are accessible only to a separate evaluator after selection.json is committed.
recovery_note: Numerical law-recovery criterion, not proof of exact symbolic equivalence. Actual formulas will also be inspected and reported.
reference_state_policy: Evaluator uses clean autonomous background at each sampled absolute t. Public reference acceleration has no probe-velocity argument (confirmed source signature); nonzero sampled candidate velocity tests spurious velocity dependence, not a missing reference argument.
failures: Keep all registered attempts; no-result/missing selected candidate scores zero. No retry or best-seed selection.
unchanged: Filter parameters, consumer, legacy quality and resolution weights
PySR operators, complexity policy, candidate exporter
limitations: One fixed observation dataset per world
Three requested SR seeds; multithreading and time-bounded search are not fully deterministic
Not evidence for nine unseen worlds or autonomous Agent success rate
